overrides.ability: Twice per game, at night, choose a different character: they are drunk for 3 nights & 3 days.
Each night, you become the alignment of an alive neighbour. If all good players choose to join your cult, your team wins. If you die at night, become good.
Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller to learn a number of in play Minion or Demon characters equal to the Day.

You start knowing an in play Outsider. They can't change character from other abilities. Once per game, at night, choose a player: that Outsider, if chosen, becomes a not in play good Townsfolk. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
If only 3 players live (travellers don't count) & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.

Once per game, at night, choose a good character: gain that ability. You may be told to reconsider. If you pick a character that's not helpful to your team or ruins the games balance 3 times, you become Drunk.
Minions & Demons do not know each other. If you die, even if drunk or poisoned, they learn who each other are at night.
You are safe from the Demon. Each night, if your ability protected you from the Demon, wake and learn this.
If you die, at night, choose Minions or Demons. All players of the type you chose picks new characters of the same type to be.
Whoever wins, loses, & whoever loses, wins. If only evil players are alive, evil wins (therefore good wins). This ability works even if you are dead.
You have 3 Outsider abilities. You know each, even if drunk or poisoned. [-0 or -1 Outsiders]
You think you are a Demon, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are & who you choose at night.
You might register as any character, alignment, or living status, even if dead.
Each Minion starts knowing a different in-play good character.
When you die, 1 player is drunk from now on. When dead, you may guess (once) which. If correct, all players learn you are the Sweetheart tonight.
Each other night*, you may choose a player & character they become (if not in play). If a potential evil-making character or Demon is made, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
If there are 5 or more alive players (not including travellers), each day, before nominations, you may publicly choose a player: they die. If executed, you only die if you lose roshambo.
On the 3rd night, choose a player: they become an evil Demon of your choice. [No Demon]

Once per game, choose to make a wish. If granted, it might have a price & leave a clue as to its nature. If you propose a declined wish for your team 3 times, you turn into a character of the same type.
Each night*, choose a player: they die. [You choose which players are which Minions, your Minion choices may be denied. -? to +? Outsiders]
